issue.title: Renamed generic agent-session root PNG is unstable before matching recapture under parallel screenshot runs

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-1q2.4 note 2 (tui-reds phase of epic sase-1q2). A full parallel screenshot run with 6 workers reported agents_renamed_generic_session_root_120x40 as unstable but passing on recapture. 20 of 20 serial -n 1 cycles of the same node were clean, the goldens were unchanged, and the harness status was clean with exit 0. Likely parallelism contention in capture readiness. Sibling per-node unstable-recapture tasks sase-1o7, sase-1o8, sase-1o9 and sase-1oa show the same symptom on other nodes and may share a root cause. Diagnose the missing semantic readiness under load. Do not raise timeouts or relax pixels.

issue.creation_reason: sase-1q2 landing triage of sase-1q2.4's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: one parallel full screenshot run reported this node unstable, and no task tracks it.
